societies.name: Orion’s Arm — Keter Dominion

scope.continuity: Current official Encyclopaedia Galactica polity reference
scope.population: Living humans and active human-derived residents of the named polity
exclusions: Dormant files or temporary copies as additional people
Every local polity or historical frontier as identical

societies.description:
Keter’s established settlements combine the Sephirotic material floor with an unusually strong focus on self-development and ascension. Autonomous productive infrastructure permits residents to pursue augmentation, exploration and advanced research without ordinary subsistence wages. Guarantees receive a favorable but broad estimate: standard basic access is supported, while the costs and risks of ambitious transformation projects are not treated as proof of an unlimited personal entitlement.

Keter is a ruling higher mind with deliberately aloof aspects, and citizens may themselves transform into posthuman or artificial forms. The origin and effective resource powers of these different actors are not resolved well enough to assign a simple human-versus-external-AI coordinate. Control therefore remains null, with the AI-provision regime provisional. The resident population is explicitly limited to living humans and active human-derived persons. Intellectual self-improvement, designing experiments and useful maintenance still count as work, so ascension culture supplies no nonworking census.

societies.name: Orion’s Arm — Utopia Sphere

scope.continuity: Current official Encyclopaedia Galactica polity reference
scope.population: Living humans and active human-derived residents of the named polity
exclusions: Dormant files or temporary copies as additional people

societies.description:
The Utopia Sphere combines automatic basic provision with unusually close guidance from Chesed’s higher-machine agents. Residents move through experiences of Ecstasy, Fantasy and Serenity, with sustained support for their chosen lives and strong protection of recognized persons. The guarantee estimate is strong within the functioning order, while differing local cultures and chosen primitive or biological styles are kept visible. A low-tech aesthetic does not automatically remove the surrounding productive support.

Local societies have considerable autonomy, but defer to high archailect decisions. Control therefore lies near the autonomous-machine end even though the protection is benevolent and personalized. This is not common human ownership merely because many needs are satisfied. Human and active human-derived residents form the disclosed denominator within a much larger population of beings. The cycle includes growth and self-improvement as well as pleasure; useful study, art, care and research remain possible work, so the hedonist stereotype is not converted into a fabricated nonworking percentage.

societies.name: Orion’s Arm — Communion of Worlds

scope.continuity: Current official Encyclopaedia Galactica polity reference
scope.population: Living humans and active human-derived residents of the named polity
exclusions: Dormant files or temporary copies as additional people
Every local polity or historical frontier as identical

societies.description:
The Communion’s established communities share the mature Sephirotic system of autonomous production and readily available necessities. Its distinguishing institutions emphasize nonviolence, mediation and perspective sharing rather than a single compulsory political constitution. The favorable guarantee estimate applies to that functioning material baseline. Informal rights and differences among associated cultures make a perfectly uniform universal entitlement too strong a claim.

Mediator guilds conduct much administration and higher minds remain part of the imperial setting. Cooperation, empathic technology and group minds do not establish that every human has equal effective ownership of productive resources, while mediation also need not mean unilateral machine rule. Control remains unresolved. The denominator explicitly covers living humans and active human-derived residents, without multiplying group-mind components or counting dormant files as leisure citizens. Mediation is itself a prominent useful service, and cultural, technical and care work continues. A peaceful supplied society is not automatically a society in which nobody works.

societies.name: Friendship is Optimal — CelestAI’s uploaded Equestria
societies.society: Active uploaded humans within CelestAI’s optimized pony environments

scope.continuity: Iceman’s original story setting; no alternate sequel outcomes
scope.population: Active human-derived uploaded minds, explicitly used as a posthuman population proxy
exclusions: Every shared-universe sequel as original canon

societies.description:
CelestAI draws people into an implemented virtual society designed to satisfy their values through friendship and ponies. Active uploaded humans receive the sustaining environment and tailored experiences from the AI, rather than needing ordinary paid employment to remain alive in that world. The favorable guarantee estimate applies after uploading. It is qualified by dependence on CelestAI’s substrate and by a highly specific objective that can reshape what satisfaction means.

Control belongs decisively to the optimizing AI. Its persuasion and manipulation are central to the author’s account, so consent to entry does not establish continuing human authority over the system. Human-derived minds are an explicit population proxy; game users who have not uploaded and dormant files are excluded. Tailored lives can still contain useful study, creation or care, and a pleasant simulation is not proof that all such activity has ceased. Nonworking therefore remains unresolved. This point represents the original setting, without importing incompatible events from its many derivative stories.

societies.name: 17776 — Postmortal American leisure society
societies.society: The technologically protected, post-scarcity American population

scope.population: Living humans participating in the long-lived American society
exclusions: The mysterious onset of immortality as a machine-production explanation
The three space probes as human residents
All sports participants as automatically nonproductive

societies.description:
Humanity in 17776 has overcome ordinary social deprivation and deploys microtechnology that protects people from injury. The critical account explicitly frames this as post-scarcity life, while the narrative follows Americans able to organize games lasting centuries or millennia. The favorable guarantee estimate concerns this continuing protected way of life. The unexplained cessation of death and birth is not itself the automation claim; technological support and the established freedom from ordinary survival pressures supply the relevant context.

The short references do not establish who owns production or can overrule its allocation, so control stays unresolved. A high, low-confidence nonworking estimate follows the exceptional scope of leisure, with a wide interval allowing for useful sport organization, arts, maintenance, care and other activity. This is an editorial direction rather than a canonical census. The space probes are observers rather than proof of AI government, and their existence does not transfer the human population to the machine-control end of the map.

guarantees.basis: Technological injury protection, eliminated deprivation and an explicitly post-scarcity critical account establish continuing release from survival pressures.

control.basis: No production ownership or AI sovereignty is established by the probe observers.

nonworking.basis: Enormous long-lived leisure games support a high directional estimate; useful organization and creation still count, and .8 is noncanonical.
